newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian retail sales fall 0.3 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian retail sales fall 0.3 pct in March.

text.p: Australian retail sales fell 0.3 percent to A$10.46 billion in March, seasonally adjusted, after rising 0.8 percent to A$10.49 billion in February, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
In March 1996, retail sales rose 0.3 percent to A$10.19 billion.
In the March quarter, real retail sales at constant average 1989/90 prices rose 2.2 percent to A$26.13 billion, seasonally adjusted, after falling 1.3 percent in the December quarter.
Analysts median expectations had centred on a flat result for March and a 2.4 percent rise in the March quarter.

The bureau said trend growth over recent months was heavily influenced by the strong 2.7 percent seasonally adjusted increase in January.
The impact of this January result will lessen over the next few months and the trend is expected to moderate accordingly, it said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
